formal_role: Defines all state variables governed by the system
systems_modeling_role: Determines what the model treats as dynamically relevant
review_warning: Omitted state variables can distort coupled behavior

formal_role: Represent how one state affects another state rate
systems_modeling_role: Encode interaction transfer feedback contagion or competition
review_warning: Coupling terms should be tied to mechanism data or explicit scenario logic

formal_role: Assign starting values to all state variables
systems_modeling_role: Determine the trajectory through state space
review_warning: Different initial states can produce different qualitative outcomes

formal_role: Control growth interaction transfer decay and recovery rates
systems_modeling_role: Define the strength and direction of system interactions
review_warning: Parameter uncertainty can strongly affect coupled dynamics

formal_role: Identifies states where all derivatives are zero
systems_modeling_role: Supports interpretation of steady states coexistence and balance points
review_warning: Equilibria are conditional on model structure and parameter values

formal_role: Defines how the coupled system is approximated over time
systems_modeling_role: Supports reproducible simulation and solver review
review_warning: Step size and solver choice can distort oscillation stability and domain constraints
